ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    m.ARECOD AS location_area,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.LODNUM) AS pallet_count
FROM dbo.invlod AS l
JOIN dbo.locmst AS m
  ON m.STOLOC = l.STOLOC
 AND m.WH_ID = l.WH_ID
WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY m.ARECOD
ORDER BY m.ARECOD;

ask.question: Which parts have no footprint detail?
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
    p.prtnum AS part_number,
    p.prt_client_id AS part_client_id
FROM dbo.prtmst AS p
WHERE p.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS d
      WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
        AND d.prtnum = p.prtnum
        AND d.prt_client_id = p.prt_client_id
  )
ORDER BY
    p.prt_client_id,
    p.prtnum;

ask.question: Count open pick work per wave / pick batch
ask.sql:
SELECT
    h.SCHBAT AS wave_pick_batch,
    b.BATSTS AS batch_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT h.WRKREF) AS open_pick_work_count,
    SUM(CAST(h.PCKQTY AS bigint) - CAST(h.APPQTY AS bigint)) AS open_each_quantity
FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr AS h
LEFT JOIN dbo.pckbat AS b
  ON b.WH_ID = h.WH_ID
 AND b.SCHBAT = h.SCHBAT
WHERE h.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND h.PCKQTY > h.APPQTY
GROUP BY h.SCHBAT, b.BATSTS
ORDER BY h.SCHBAT;

ask.question: List the 20 most recent inventory movements with part, quantity and from / to location
warnings: The answer had no SQL block - showing the last successful SQL the agent ran.
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP 200
       d.ACTCOD,
       d.OPRCOD,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS TRANSACTION_COUNT,
       MAX(d.TRNDTE) AS MOST_RECENT_TRANSACTION
FROM dbo.dlytrn AS d
WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND d.FRSTOL IS NOT NULL
  AND d.TOSTOL IS NOT NULL
  AND d.FRSTOL <> d.TOSTOL
GROUP BY d.ACTCOD, d.OPRCOD
ORDER BY MOST_RECENT_TRANSACTION DESC;

ask.question: How many locations exist per area, and how many of them are empty?
ask.sql:
WITH occupied_locations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        i.WH_ID,
        i.STOLOC
    FROM dbo.invlod AS i
    WHERE i.WH_ID = @wh_id
)
SELECT
    l.ARECOD AS area_code,
    COUNT(*) AS location_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.STOLOC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_location_count
FROM dbo.locmst AS l
LEFT JOIN occupied_locations AS o
    ON o.WH_ID = l.WH_ID
   AND o.STOLOC = l.STOLOC
WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY l.ARECOD
ORDER BY l.ARECOD;

ask.question: Inventory quantity per part and inventory status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    d.prtnum AS part_number,
    d.prt_client_id AS part_client_id,
    d.invsts AS inventory_status,
    SUM(CAST(d.untqty AS bigint)) AS inventory_quantity
FROM dbo.invdtl AS d
INNER JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
    ON s.subnum = d.subnum
INNER JOIN dbo.invlod AS l
    ON l.lodnum = s.lodnum
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY
    d.prtnum,
    d.prt_client_id,
    d.invsts
ORDER BY
    d.prtnum,
    d.prt_client_id,
    d.invsts;

ask.question: Top 20 parts by number of pallets in stock
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP 20
    d.prtnum AS PartNumber,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.lodnum) AS PalletCount
FROM prodwms.invlod AS l
INNER JOIN prodwms.invsub AS s
    ON s.lodnum = l.lodnum
INNER JOIN prodwms.invdtl AS d
    ON d.subnum = s.subnum
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND d.untqty > 0
GROUP BY d.prtnum
ORDER BY PalletCount DESC, PartNumber;

ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.locatn AS l
LEFT JOIN live3.unitld AS u
    ON u.subsit = l.subsit
   AND u.locatn = l.locatn
GROUP BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod
ORDER BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod;

ask.question: Top 20 items by number of unit loads in stock
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (20)
    ud.itmcls AS item_class,
    ud.itmcod AS item_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ul.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.unitld AS ul
INNER JOIN live3.untdtl AS ud
    ON ud.ulid = ul.ulid
WHERE ul.subsit IN ('0', '1')
GROUP BY
    ud.itmcls,
    ud.itmcod
ORDER BY
    unit_load_count DESC,
    ud.itmcls,
    ud.itmcod;

ask.question: How many shipments are there in each shipment status?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    s.shpsts AS shipment_status,
    COUNT(*) AS shipment_count
FROM dbo.shipment AS s
WHERE s.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY s.shpsts
ORDER BY s.shpsts;

ask.question: Total picked and shipped quantity per shipment status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    s.SHPSTS AS shipment_status,
    SUM(CAST(ISNULL(sl.PCKQTY, 0) AS bigint)) AS total_picked_quantity,
    SUM(CAST(ISNULL(sl.SHPQTY, 0) AS bigint)) AS total_shipped_quantity
FROM dbo.shipment AS s
INNER JOIN dbo.shipment_line AS sl
    ON sl.SHIP_ID = s.SHIP_ID
   AND sl.WH_ID = s.WH_ID
WHERE s.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND sl.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY s.SHPSTS
ORDER BY s.SHPSTS;

ask.question: How many receiving trucks are there in each receiving status?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    r.rcvtrk_stat AS receiving_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.trknum) AS receiving_truck_count
FROM dbo.rcvtrk AS r
WHERE r.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY r.rcvtrk_stat
ORDER BY r.rcvtrk_stat;

ask.question: Expected versus received quantity per receiving truck status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    t.rcvtrk_stat AS receiving_truck_status,
    SUM(CAST(l.expqty AS bigint)) AS expected_quantity,
    SUM(CAST(l.rcvqty AS bigint)) AS received_quantity
FROM dbo.rcvtrk AS t
JOIN dbo.rcvinv AS i
    ON i.trknum = t.trknum
   AND i.wh_id = t.wh_id
JOIN dbo.rcvlin AS l
    ON l.trknum = i.trknum
   AND l.invnum = i.invnum
   AND l.wh_id = i.wh_id
WHERE t.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND i.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY t.rcvtrk_stat
ORDER BY t.rcvtrk_stat;

ask.question: How many trailers are there in each trailer status?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trlr_stat, ''), '(No status)') AS trailer_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT trlr_id) AS trailer_count
FROM dbo.trlr
WHERE stoloc_wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(trlr_stat, ''), '(No status)')
ORDER BY trailer_status;

ask.question: How many inventory counts were recorded per count type?

convert.title: CBO_P_CLASS_INVENTORY_DE07_VIEW
convert.sql:
WITH stock AS (
    SELECT l.STOLOC,
           l.LODNUM,
           d.PRTNUM,
           d.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
           d.LOTNUM,
           d.INVSTS,
           d.FIFDTE,
           d.FTPCOD,
           d.SUP_LOTNUM,
           SUM(d.UNTQTY) AS UNTQTY
    FROM dbo.invlod AS l
    INNER JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
        ON s.LODNUM = l.LODNUM
    INNER JOIN dbo.invdtl AS d
        ON d.SUBNUM = s.SUBNUM
    WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
    GROUP BY l.STOLOC, l.LODNUM, d.PRTNUM, d.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
             d.LOTNUM, d.INVSTS, d.FIFDTE, d.FTPCOD, d.SUP_LOTNUM
)
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 200
       d.STOLOC AS LOCATN,
       d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
       p.PRTFAM AS ITMGRP,
       d.LODNUM AS ULID20,
       CAST(FLOOR(CASE
                      WHEN ISNULL(rcv.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.UNTQTY
                      ELSE CAST(d.UNTQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / rcv.UNTQTY
                  END) AS numeric(22,0)) AS CASQTY,
       d.INVSTS AS QASTAT,
       d.FIFDTE AS FIFODT,
       d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
       d.FTPCOD AS ULPALL,
       m.ARECOD AS ZONCOD,
       GETDATE() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
                 AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time' AS last_update,
       CASE LEFT(m.ARECOD, 2)
           WHEN '01' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 1')
           WHEN '02' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 2')
           WHEN '03' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 3')
           WHEN '04' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 4')
           WHEN '05' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Halle 5')
           ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
       END AS BLDING,
       CASE
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'W' OR p.PRTFAM = 'PAPPWP'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Wipes')
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'R'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Rawmaterial')
           WHEN LEFT(p.PRTFAM, 1) = 'P'
               THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Packmaterial')
           ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
       END AS MATTYP,
       CASE WHEN pal.HGT > 1 THEN CONVERT(int, pal.HGT) END AS calculated_pal_height,
       rcv.UOMCOD AS UOM,
       LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4) AS VNDCOD,
       SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 4000) AS VNDLOT,
       CONCAT(d.FTPCOD, d.PRTNUM) AS ULPAL_ITEM
FROM stock AS d
INNER JOIN dbo.locmst AS m
    ON m.STOLOC = d.STOLOC
   AND m.WH_ID = @wh_id
INNER JOIN dbo.aremst AS a
    ON a.ARECOD = m.ARECOD
   AND a.WH_ID = m.WH_ID
INNER JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
    ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
   AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
   AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1
           u.UOMCOD,
           u.UNTQTY
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS u
    WHERE u.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
      AND u.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
      AND u.FTPCOD = d.FTPCOD
      AND u.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND u.RCV_FLG = 1
    ORDER BY u.UOMLVL, u.UOMCOD
) AS rcv
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1
           u.HGT
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS u
    WHERE u.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
      AND u.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
      AND u.FTPCOD = d.FTPCOD
      AND u.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND u.PAL_FLG = 1
    ORDER BY u.UOMLVL DESC, u.UOMCOD
) AS pal
WHERE p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
  AND a.BLDG_ID = 'B1';

convert.title: Direct_LINE_BEVO_PRIORITIES
convert.sql:
WITH rl AS (
    SELECT l.LODNUM,
           l.STOLOC AS locatn,
           d.PRTNUM AS itmcod,
           d.LOTNUM AS ctlgrp,
           NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS vndcod,
           NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS vndlot
    FROM dbo.invlod AS l
    JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
      ON s.LODNUM = l.LODNUM
    JOIN dbo.invdtl AS d
      ON d.SUBNUM = s.SUBNUM
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = l.WH_ID
    WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND l.STOLOC NOT LIKE '%RWZ%'
      AND d.INVSTS = 'U'
),
B AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LODNUM) AS ULIDs,
           locatn,
           itmcod,
           vndlot,
           vndcod
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY locatn, itmcod, vndlot, vndcod
),
D AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LODNUM) AS ULIDs,
           vndcod,
           vndlot
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY vndcod, vndlot
),
A AS (
    SELECT h.PRDLIN AS PLNUMB,
           h.WKONUM AS PRDORD,
           h.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
           w.PRTNUM AS SPCCOD,
           w.WKOLIN AS LINSEQ,
           w.PRCLOC AS LOCATN,
           w.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
           NULLIF(LEFT(w.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
           NULLIF(SUBSTRING(w.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
           h.WKOSTS,
           h.SCH_BEGDTE,
           h.SCH_ENDDTE,
           w.LINQTY - w.TOT_DLVQTY AS open_qty
    FROM dbo.wkohdr AS h
    JOIN dbo.wkodtl AS w
      ON w.WKONUM = h.WKONUM
     AND w.WKOREV = h.WKOREV
     AND w.WH_ID = h.WH_ID
     AND w.CLIENT_ID = h.CLIENT_ID
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM = w.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = w.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = w.WH_ID
    WHERE h.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND h.WKOSTS IN ('P', 'I')
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND w.PRCLOC IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT A.PLNUMB,
       A.PRDORD,
       CASE WHEN A.WKOSTS = 'I' AND A.open_qty > 0
            THEN A.SCH_BEGDTE END AS ACTDAT,
       CASE WHEN A.WKOSTS = 'I' AND A.open_qty > 0
            THEN A.SCH_ENDDTE END AS ENDDAT,
       A.ITMCOD,
       A.SPCCOD,
       A.LINSEQ,
       A.LOCATN,
       A.CTLGRP,
       A.VNDCOD,
       A.VNDLOT,
       B.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
       D.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
       FORMAT(
           CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time' AS datetime),
           'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm'
       ) AS Last_Update
FROM A
LEFT JOIN B
  ON A.SPCCOD = B.itmcod
 AND A.LOCATN = B.locatn
 AND A.VNDLOT = B.vndlot
 AND A.VNDCOD = B.vndcod
LEFT JOIN D
  ON A.VNDCOD = D.vndcod
 AND A.VNDLOT = D.vndlot
UNION
SELECT NULL AS PLNUMB,
       NULL AS PRDORD,
       NULL AS ACTDAT,
       NULL AS ENDDAT,
       NULL AS ITMCOD,
       NULL AS SPCCOD,
       NULL AS LINSEQ,
       NULL AS LOCATN,
       NULL AS CTLGRP,
       NULL AS VNDCOD,
       NULL AS VNDLOT,
       NULL AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
       NULL AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
       FORMAT(MAX(t.TRNDTE), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm') AS Last_Update
FROM dbo.dlytrn AS t;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT
        d.TOSTOL AS LOCATN,
        d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
        d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
        NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
        NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
        CAST(
            FLOOR(
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                    ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
                END
            ) AS numeric(22,0)
        ) AS TRNQTY,
        ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
        CASE
            WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
            ELSE w.WKONUM
        END AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.LODNUM, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            f.UOMCOD,
            f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
                  d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
                  d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
              )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
            x.LOCALE_ID
    ) ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.prod_line pl
          WHERE pl.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
            AND pl.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
)
SELECT TOP 200
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m;

    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT
        d.FRSTOL AS LOCATN,
        d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
        d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
        NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
        NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
        CAST(FLOOR(
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
            END
        ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS TRNQTY,
        ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
        CASE
            WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
            ELSE w.WKONUM
        END AS PRDORD,
        d.LODNUM AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn AS d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst AS p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr AS ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl AS pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) AS w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            f.UOMCOD,
            f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) AS u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc AS x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
          )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
    ) AS ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst AS lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ AS t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst AS lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ AS t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    CASE LOCATN
        WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4'
        WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3'
        ELSE LOCATN
    END AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT d.FRSTOL AS LOCATN,
           d.TRNDTE AS SYSDAT,
           d.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
           LEFT(ds.LNGDSC, 15) AS ITMDSC,
           d.LOTNUM AS CTLGRP,
           NULLIF(LEFT(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 4), '') AS VNDCOD,
           NULLIF(SUBSTRING(d.SUP_LOTNUM, 5, 100), '') AS VNDLOT,
           CAST(FLOOR(CASE
               WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
               ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
           END) AS numeric(22,0)) AS TRNQTY,
           ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOM,
           CASE
               WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                   THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
               ELSE w.WKONUM
           END AS PRDORD,
           d.LODNUM AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = ph.WH_ID
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = d.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 f.UOMCOD,
                     f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 x.LNGDSC
        FROM dbo.prtdsc x
        WHERE x.COLNAM = 'prtnum|prt_client_id|wh_id_tmpl'
          AND x.COLVAL IN (
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|' + d.WH_ID,
              d.PRTNUM + '|' + d.PRT_CLIENT_ID + '|----'
          )
          AND x.LNGDSC IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN x.COLVAL LIKE '%|----' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
                 CASE WHEN x.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
                 x.LOCALE_ID
    ) ds
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.locmst lm
          JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
            ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
           AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
          WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
            AND lm.WH_ID = d.WH_ID
            AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
      )
      AND d.TRNDTE > DATEADD(day, -33, GETDATE())
      AND d.TRNDTE <= GETDATE()
)
SELECT TOP 200
       LOCATN AS LINE,
       FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       ITMCOD,
       ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
       CTLGRP,
       VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
       VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
       TRNQTY AS QTY,
       UOM AS WM_UNIT,
       PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       ULID,
       CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM m;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURNS_90days_wholeQtyBack
convert.sql:
WITH moves AS (
    SELECT d.TRNDTE,
           d.PRTNUM,
           d.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
           d.LODNUM,
           d.FRSTOL,
           d.TOSTOL,
           CAST(FLOOR(
               CASE
                   WHEN ISNULL(u.UNTQTY, 0) = 0 THEN d.TRNQTY
                   ELSE CAST(d.TRNQTY AS decimal(19,3)) / u.UNTQTY
               END
           ) AS numeric(22,0)) AS QTY,
           ISNULL(u.UOMCOD, p.STKUOM) AS UOMCOD,
           CASE
               WHEN EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                   FROM dbo.locmst lm
                   JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
                     ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
                    AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
                   WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.TOSTOL
                     AND lm.WH_ID = @wh_id
                     AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
               ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
           END AS to_line,
           CASE
               WHEN EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                   FROM dbo.locmst lm
                   JOIN dbo.loc_typ t
                     ON t.LOC_TYP_ID = lm.LOC_TYP_ID
                    AND t.WH_ID = lm.WH_ID
                   WHERE lm.STOLOC = d.FRSTOL
                     AND lm.WH_ID = @wh_id
                     AND t.LOC_TYP_CAT = 'PROD'
               ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
           END AS from_line
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = d.WH_ID
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
               f.UOMCOD,
               f.UNTQTY
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl f
        WHERE f.PRTNUM = d.PRTNUM
          AND f.PRT_CLIENT_ID = d.PRT_CLIENT_ID
          AND f.WH_ID = @wh_id
          AND f.RCV_FLG = 1
        ORDER BY f.UOMLVL
    ) u
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.LODNUM IS NOT NULL
      AND p.TYPCOD = 'ROH'
),
RankedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT m.TRNDTE AS DELIVERY_DATE,
           m.TOSTOL AS LINE,
           CASE
               WHEN w.WKONUM LIKE '000%' AND LEN(w.WKONUM) = 12
                   THEN SUBSTRING(w.WKONUM, 4, 9)
               ELSE w.WKONUM
           END AS PROCESS_ORDER,
           m.PRTNUM AS ITMCOD,
           p.PRTFAM AS ITMGRP,
           g.LNGDSC AS grpdsc,
           m.QTY,
           m.UOMCOD AS WHSE_UNIT,
           m.LODNUM AS ULID,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY m.LODNUM
               ORDER BY m.TRNDTE ASC
           ) AS DeliveryRank
    FROM moves m
    JOIN dbo.prtmst p
      ON p.PRTNUM = m.PRTNUM
     AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = m.PRT_CLIENT_ID
     AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.dscmst g
      ON g.COLNAM = 'prtfam'
     AND g.COLVAL = p.PRTFAM
     AND g.LOCALE_ID = 'US_ENGLISH'
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
               pd.WKONUM
        FROM dbo.pckwrk_hdr ph
        JOIN dbo.pckwrk_dtl pd
          ON pd.WRKREF = ph.WRKREF
         AND pd.WH_ID = @wh_id
        WHERE ph.LODNUM = m.LODNUM
          AND ph.WH_ID = @wh_id
          AND pd.WKONUM IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY pd.LAST_UPD_DT DESC
    ) w
    WHERE m.to_line = 1
      AND m.TRNDTE > CAST(GETDATE() - 90 AS date)
      AND m.TRNDTE < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
      AND m.TOSTOL NOT LIKE 'SLA%'
      AND m.TOSTOL NOT LIKE 'SLC%'
),
RankedReturns AS (
    SELECT m.LODNUM AS ULID,
           m.TRNDTE AS RETURN_DATE,
           m.QTY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY m.LODNUM
               ORDER BY m.TRNDTE ASC
           ) AS ReturnRank
    FROM moves m
    WHERE m.from_line = 1
      AND m.to_line = 0
)
SELECT TOP 200
       d.DELIVERY_DATE,
       d.LINE,
       d.PROCESS_ORDER,
       d.ITMCOD,
       d.ITMGRP,
       d.grpdsc,
       d.QTY,
       d.WHSE_UNIT,
       d.ULID,
       r.RETURN_DATE,
       r.QTY AS RETURN_QTY,
       DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) AS DATE_DIFF
FROM RankedDeliveries d
JOIN RankedReturns r
  ON r.ULID = d.ULID
 AND r.ReturnRank = d.DeliveryRank
WHERE d.DELIVERY_DATE < r.RETURN_DATE
  AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) < 960
  AND d.QTY = r.QTY
ORDER BY d.ULID, d.DELIVERY_DATE ASC;
